subject: Request: Single-invoice exception for pilot onboarding — ClientCorp
messages:
From: Claire Dobbins <claire.d@clientcorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@clientcorp.com>
Date: 2025-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: single-invoice exception for 30-day pilot

Hi Hannah,

We're excited to start the 30-day pilot with Redwood next week. Our procurement team needs the vendor onboarding package before we can issue a PO. Given the pilot's short duration and low spend, can Redwood accept a single invoice at pilot completion instead of a PO? If so, please share the onboarding form and any evidence required (SOC2, etc.) so we can expedite.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dobbins
Head of Procurement, ClientCorp
Attachment: clientcorp-onboarding-reqs.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dobbins <claire.d@clientcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: single-invoice exception for 30-day pilot

Hi Claire —

Thanks — excited to run this with you. Short answer: we can consider a temporary "single-invoice" path for pilots under $10k with an exceptions approval, provided the onboarding checklist and SOC2 evidence are complete. I've looped in Marissa (sales ops) and David (finance) to confirm the approval steps and any additional paperwork needed.

Next steps I recommend:
- I’ll send our vendor intake form and the SOC2 export.
- Marissa, can you confirm the internal exception approval lead time and whether we need a temporary contract addendum?
- David, what invoice and remittance info do you need on your side to accept a single invoice after pilot close?

I'll attach the intake form in my next email.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Lead, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: none yet

Hannah —

We can route this as a sales-op exception. Approval path:
1) Sales ops review (Marissa) — checklist + export of SOC2
2) Finance sign-off (David) — confirm AR routing and PO waiver
3) Legal quick addendum (if ClientCorp requests contract language)

Estimate 48 hours if we have completed onboarding_form + SOC2 PDF. If they need the addendum, add another 48.

Forwarding to Claire with the intake form and the short exception request template.
